mapper.sql: WITH saved_source AS ( SELECT l.id AS log_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.inboundPlanId')) AS inbound_plan_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.shipmentId')) AS shipment_id, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.sid')) AS UNSIGNED) AS sid, JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.boxes') AS boxes_json, l.request_body, l.success_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.inboundPlanId')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.shipmentId')) ORDER BY l.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM customs_shipment_fee_import_log l WHERE l.business_type = 'PACKING_INFO' AND l.status = 'SUCCESS' AND l.request_body IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(l.request_body) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.inboundPlanId')) IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.request_body, '$.shipmentId')) IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT sub.id, saved.inbound_plan_id, MAX(saved.sid) AS sid, MAX(plan.position_type) AS position_type, COALESCE(sub.status, 'READY') AS status, sub.task_id, sub.payload_hash, sub.request_body, sub.initial_response_body, sub.final_response_body, sub.request_id, sub.error_message, COALESCE(sub.attempt_count, 0) AS attempt_count, sub.operator, sub.submit_time, sub.success_time, sub.failed_time, sub.last_poll_time, sub.create_time, sub.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT saved.shipment_id) AS saved_shipment_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lingxing_sta_inbound_plan_shipment ps WHERE ps.inbound_plan_id = saved.inbound_plan_id ) AS expected_shipment_count, COALESCE(SUM(JSON_LENGTH(saved.boxes_json)), 0) AS box_count, MAX(saved.success_time) AS last_saved_time FROM saved_source saved LEFT JOIN lingxing_sta_inbound_plan plan ON plan.inbound_plan_id = saved.inbound_plan_id LEFT JOIN customs_packing_submission sub ON sub.inbound_plan_id = saved.inbound_plan_id WHERE saved.row_num = 1
AND saved.inbound_plan_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{inboundPlanId}, '%')
AND COALESCE(sub.status, 'READY') = #{status}
GROUP BY saved.inbound_plan_id, sub.id ORDER BY MAX(saved.success_time) DESC, saved.inbound_plan_id
SELECT log_id, inbound_plan_id, shipment_id, sid, request_body, success_time FROM saved_source WHERE row_num = 1 AND inbound_plan_id = #{inboundPlanId} ORDER BY shipment_id
SELECT position_type FROM lingxing_sta_inbound_plan WHERE inbound_plan_id = #{inboundPlanId} ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM customs_packing_submission WHERE status IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN') AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND task_id <> '' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_poll_time, submit_time), id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE customs_packing_submission SET status = 'SUBMITTING', operator = #{operator}, submit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), success_time = NULL, failed_time = NULL, error_message = NULL, initial_response_body = NULL, final_response_body = NULL, request_id = NULL, task_id = NULL, last_poll_time = NULL, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbound_plan_id = #{inboundPlanId} AND status IN ('READY', 'FAILED')

UPDATE customs_packing_submission SET sid = #{sid}, position_type = #{positionType}, payload_hash = #{payloadHash}, request_body = #{requestBody}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUBMITTING'

UPDATE customs_packing_submission SET status = #{status}, task_id = #{taskId}, request_id = #{requestId}, initial_response_body = #{responseBody}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, success_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCESS' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, failed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END, last_poll_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE last_poll_time END, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE customs_packing_submission SET status = #{status}, request_id = COALESCE(#{requestId}, request_id), final_response_body = #{responseBody}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, success_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCESS' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE success_time END, failed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE failed_time END, last_poll_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PROCESSING', 'UNKNOWN')
